worldcombat.skill.triplearrows.summary: Sweep a low, close-range kick at a direction point or a chosen target to pry the guard open, then three arrows leave the string at once: all three can take one target, or a fan can cover several. The leg only reaches close range, so it never invents a kick on a distant target - only the arrows fly far. Only the target this kick actually struck gets pinned on a weak point, and heavy arrow force can lock it out of acting.
worldcombat.skill.triplearrows.descripti: The low kick reaches only %3$s blocks and deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block kick radius; out of reach it is just a short sweep.

%1$s s after the kick, three arrows fire at once, each dealing about %2$s damage, %3$s degrees off centre, %4$s blocks per tick, %5$s blocks of range (also the move's real reach) and a %6$s block arrow radius; all three can take one target, or spread across targets in fan volley, and walls stop the arrows.

A landed kick has a %1$s chance to kick the guard open: the target's Defence drops %2$s stage (the drop stays until it is reset or the target switches out) and a %3$s guard gap is left; the gap itself adds nothing, but other guard-breaking moves can keep consuming it. Only the target this kick actually struck takes critical hits from this cast's arrows. The first of the three arrows to hit has a %4$s chance to flinch the target for %5$s, interrupting any interruptible action; while flinched the target cannot start new moves or make ordinary attacks.
worldcombat.skill.triplearrows.fan.on: Fan volley: three arrows spread 14 degrees, 15 percent lighter each, to cover targets bunched together, with a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.triplearrows.fan.off: Focused volley: three arrows almost on one line, 5 percent heavier each, harder on a single target.

worldcombat.skill.triplearrows.growth.1: From level %1$s each arrow rises to %2$s and the guard gap lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.triplearrows.use.0: Kick the guard open, then fire three arrows
worldcombat.skill.triplearrows.use.1: Fan a volley across targets bunched together
worldcombat.skill.triplearrows.use.2: A high-crit mid-range burst on one target
